answer: The price of trying is a deposit of 77 credits, frozen until 10 days after the grading closes, paid up front for every single name, while the marble stays small. The counter asks for Saltbound salt watchman crystal licence first, and a licence salt watchmen carry after watch house audits is the answer it accepts. The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. The voyage is on the docket. The terrace is checked, not assumed.
